Leftists have their extremists, as do all philosophies

Suppose you asked taxi cab drivers to make a list of ALL the things that were
wrong with society, and then suppose you instituted EVERY social change
that they demanded. It is safe to say that within a couple of years the
majority of taxi cab drivers would find something new to complain about, some
new social "evil" to correct because, once again, the taxi cab driver is
motivated less by distress at society's ills than by the need to satisfy
his drive for power by imposing his solutions on society.
